candidates.statement: Payment service calls from order time out (ReadTimeout, ~2.0s) on every checkout trace, causing order and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502; inventory/redis calls succeed, so the fault is downstream payment latency.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side metrics/logs admitted; payment latency cause (saturation vs. network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: All four checkout traces show payment POST /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout while inventory/redis succeed, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s with p95 ~2406ms. Topology confirms order->payment dependency. Bounded to downstream payment latency.
